text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - President Michal Kovac on Thursday signed the 1997 state budget, approved by parliament earlier this month. But Kovac said that expansive government projects would increase Slovakia's indebtedness and will have negative impact on loan sources for the economy.
- Steel producer VSZ Kosice said it expected higher net profit this year than last year's 1.24 billion crowns.
- Trade between Slovakia and Poland totalled some $572 million in the firs ten months of this year and it is expected to increase to some $700 million by the end of next year.

HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The Confederation of Trade Unions and the Association of Employers said they would demand that the goverment present its economic strategy for the next two years before January negotiations on the general agreement for next year.
- The extraordinary meeting of the Czech-Slovak customs union will on Saturday discuss a Slovak plan to impose quotas on imports of some Czech agricultural products.
- The meeting will also discuss the Slovak plan to sign a free-trade agreement with Russia.
PRAVDA - Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar will visit France in the first quarter of next year. Meciar is expected to meet his French counterpart Alain Juppe.
